title.narrative: Responding to provide urgent support and enhance the resilience of displaced and host communities in rural areas of Deir ez-Zor, Homs, and Damascus. Envelop1.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe humanitarian situations in Rural Damascus, Homs, and Deir ez-Zor reflect both Syria's profound challenges and fragile hopes during this transition period. While PiN have increased and some international sanctions have eased, explosive hazards, damaged infrastructure, economic collapse, and systemic vulnerabilities continue to endanger civilians. With humanitarian funding critically low and needs remaining immense, the international community faces urgent choices about sustaining support for Syria's transition while ensuring lifesaving assistance reaches those most in need.lt/pgtltpgtGOPA-DERD intervention through this program will be in the following sectors from the ltbgtEnvelop1lt/bgt:ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbgtltugtFSA:lt/ugtlt/bgtlt/pgtltpgtMassive depletion of livelihoods infrastructure, high levels of unemployment and poverty coupled with high food prices and inflation have all contributed to low purchasing power, as households struggle to meet their daily food needs. The project will contribute to food insecurity through:lt/pgtltpgt- Rehabilitation of irrigation canals: GOPA already complete successfully rehabilitation of 800 meters long cannel in Khsham and proposed location through this program will be Complementing the previous project implemented through the SHF Program# 33331 program, and in response to a request from the Agriculture Directorate in the region. The request is attached Ref# 006. lt/pgtltpgt- Rehabilitation of bakeries: this activity will target rehabilitation of one bakery in Al-Qusayr/ rural Homs and one in Babella/ rural Damascus to secure the basic needs of high quality daily bread to 35,000 H.H.ltbrgtThe works will include renovating the bakery building, supplying and installing a new production line, and supplying an electric generating.ltbrgtBakeries Committee request attached refltbgt#006.lt/bgtlt/pgtltpgtltbgtltugtEducation:lt/ugtlt/bgtlt/pgtltpgt- Safe reopening of schools requires light rehabilitation of minorly ltbgtdamaged schoolslt/bgt to ensure resumption of learning for school aged children. GOPA-DERD alongside with Education Sector will continue to provide support in the affected areas in Khsham, Babella, and and Al-Qusayr rural Homs, Damascus and Deir ez Zur by targting one school in each area. Ministry of Education request attached Ref#ltbgt006lt/bgtlt/pgtltpgt- ltbgt30lt/bgt ltbgtRemedial Classeslt/bgt Course will implemented to 600 students in target areas. 20 students ( boys and girls) will attend in each session. The session duration will be three months, and consist of 180 classes.lt/pgtltpgt- Campaigns and initiatives will also be organized for ltbgtBTLlt/bgt in the target areas, aim at bringing children back to their schools by spreading awareness about the importance of education, targeting parents with educational lectures on this topic, and conducting activities and motivational initiatives for children and adolescents.lt/pgtltpgtltbgtltugtProtection:lt/ugt lt/bgtthe protection project will focus on the following activities in the target areas: lt/pgtltpgtltbgt90 CP sessions: lt/bgtChildhood is one of the most important and fundamental stages in the development of the human being and the cornerstone for preparing a person who enjoys good psychological, social and physical health. Given the nature of this stage and the increasing risks to which children are exposed as a result of conflicts, economic and social crises, family problems and violence, this negatively affects their psychological and physical safety, and leads to high rates of school dropout, child labor, domestic violence and other risks.lt/pgtltpgtltbgt90 PSS PFA and 90 structure sessions:lt/bgt Various crises, including trauma, conflict, war, displacement, and various stressors, affect the psychological well-being of individuals, especially vulnerable groups. This often leads to a range of psychological disorders, ranging in severity from feelings of stress to psychological disorders such as depression, anxiety, and post-traumatic stress disorder. The effects of these disorders are evident in a decline in the individual's functional performance and social relationships. This project aims to empower individuals and communities to adapt positively and enhance resilience through multi-level psychosocial support.lt/pgt
